findings.summary: Scope step can wrongly set run=false (git diff failure, or SIGPIPE from grep -q on a very large diff under pipefail), skipping a PR-time scan. Push to main and the weekly scan limit the damage. Fix: capture the diff to a variable and fail on git diff error, or use grep without -q.
